På spansk teller ikke aksentene, som i s: In Spanish the accents do not count, as in Spanish Scrabble: «canción» is laid as CANCION. Ñ is a letter of its own. CH, LL and RR are laid with plain letters, and verb forms with a pronoun on the end («dámelo») count.
